initial_fixture_compile_errors.description: Receipt comparison placeholder substitution corrected before behavioral reproduction; no acceptance attributed to these runs.

limitations: Eight new cases use actual native game objects and native NBT serialization within the ordinary scenario JVM. They do not constitute a new separate-process live-mutation restart suite.
Retained evidence and original tokens are preserved; no provider outcomes/routes are inferred, and no recovery/redemption/replay/mint/fence-clear action is implemented.
Public Java field mutation fixtures are an API robustness boundary, not proof of a network/client exploit.

Installed-provider identity/API/authorization/durability, dedicated multiplayer/online profiles/real dimension travel, arbitrary user/modpack saves, pre-save/power-loss atomicity, reviewed reconciliation, sustained performance and broader parity remain open.

controller_repair.description: Exact 1.6.4 native log lines carry the dated INFO STDOUT prefix; normalize only that anchored prefix before checking unique whole PASS markers. Original controller run may fail its marker check; no native failure inferred.

hourly.scope: Exact-source native revalidation only; client/provider/multiplayer/performance acceptance remains separate

opaque_export.scope: Verified captured bytes only; no provider identity, ownership or outcome authentication
